description: Nhóm sản phẩm dùng để tra cam kết SLA (BC5)
etl_logic: JOIN STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY ON STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.APPLICATION_SK = STG_DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_SK → JOIN STG_DIM_RLOS_PRODUCT ON STG_DIM_RLOS_PRODUCT.PRODUCT_SK = STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.PRODUCT_SK → LEFT JOIN RLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHCN ON (CASE WHEN RLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHCN.PRODUCT_LINE = 'Trường Change Request' THEN RLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHCN.PRODUCT_LINE = STG_DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION.CHANGE_TYPE ELSE RLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHCN.PRODUCT_LINE = STG_DIM_RLOS_PRODUCT.PRODUCT_LINE_NAME END) AND (RLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHCN.DEVIATION_G3 IS NULL OR RLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHCN.DEVIATION_G3 = STG_DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION.DEVIATION_G3) AND (RLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHCN.SECONDARY_PRODUCTLINE IS NULL OR RLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHCN.SECONDARY_PRODUCTLINE = CASE WHEN STG_DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION.IS_SEC_PRODUCT = 'Có' THEN 'YES' WHEN STG_DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION.IS_SEC_PRODUCT = 'Không' THEN 'NO' END) AND RLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHCN.APP_GRP = STG_DIM_RLOS_APPLICATION.APP_GRP → RLOS_REF_SLA_TDKHCN.REF_PRODUCT
note: PRODUCT_LINE_NAME lấy gián tiếp qua STG_FCT_RLOS_APPLICATION_DAILY.PRODUCT_SK → STG_DIM_RLOS_PRODUCT (DIM này không có PRODUCT_SK trực tiếp). DEVIATION_G3/SECONDARY_PRODUCTLINE bỏ qua điều kiện nếu REF_ để trống (SRS BC5/BC9, review 2026-09-18)
